independent_derivation_or_calculation: Consider a planar lamina in the xy-plane. For any mass element dm at (x,y), its distance from x-axis is y, so Ix = int y^2 dm. Its distance from y-axis is x, so Iy = int x^2 dm. Its distance from the z-axis (perpendicular to plane) is r = sqrt(x^2 + y^2). Thus Iz = int r^2 dm = int (x^2 + y^2) dm = int x^2 dm + int y^2 dm = Iy + Ix.
findings: First-principles derivation matched claimed theorem exactly.
